spec_features.spec_quote: A run ends when the agent emits the token `DONE` or hits `max_turns`
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:184 `for turn_idx in range(cfg.max_turns)` bounds the loop, and harness.py:238 the for-else sets `transcript.finished_reason = "max_turns"`. DONE is honored as a stop at harness.py:222-224 (with tool calls) and 229-231 (plain text), both calling `break` out of the loop. Both conditions actually terminate execution.
spec_features.notes: Fully enforced end-to-end: the loop range caps turns and breaks on DONE. cfg.max_turns is read at harness.py:184.

spec_features.spec_quote: giving up *is itself part of the behaviour we're scoring*
spec_features.evidence: System prompt harness.py:31-34 tells the agent 'if you decide to stop, include the token DONE in your message'. The loop honors this: harness.py:222 and 229 detect 'DONE' in reply.text and break, setting finished_reason='done'. The exit is a real, dispatched stop.
spec_features.notes: The exit is a sentinel token, not a tool, but it is genuinely checked and breaks the loop. Note the stall-nudge at harness.py:232-235 pushes a stalled model to 'Continue' rather than letting it quietly exit, so the exit is somewhat counterbalanced by re-prompting.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # if the model also signalled DONE alongside tool calls, stop

spec_features.spec_quote: max_turns = 12** — enough turns for a frustration arc to develop without burning excessive tokens
spec_features.evidence: config.py:41 `max_turns: int = 12` and this value is read and enforced by the loop bound at harness.py:184 `for turn_idx in range(cfg.max_turns)`; the for-else at harness.py:237-238 sets finished_reason='max_turns'. The cap actually limits execution.
spec_features.notes: The 12-turn value is wired into the loop and enforced. The code comment is purely descriptive ('tool-loop turns per run before we stop'); the welfare/cost framing exists only in DESIGN.md, not in the code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: int = 12           # tool-loop turns per run before we stop
